procedural_matters: Protest was filed via a paper form not through Racing Rules of Sailling
facts: UKR was approaching the 1st windward mark on starboard, having just tacked inside the zone about 2-3 bL from the mark
IRL was approaching the mark on port tack
IRl tacked from port to starboard at the mark
UKR altered her course to avoid IRL before IRL reached a close-hauled course
There was no contact between the boats
conclusions: After passing head to wind and before being on a close-hauled course, IRL failed to keep clear of UKR. IRL broke RRS 13.
